replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used a math app to check my homework and practice problems. It was helpful for quick explanations and step-by-step solutions. I felt confident using it to clarify concepts without getting stuck.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it’s positive, you get two real roots; if zero, one real root; if negative, complex roots. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a) to find the solutions.

To find stationary points, first take the derivative f’(x). Set f’(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are potential stationary points. Plug them back into f(x) to get the y-values. Check if they’re maxima, minima, or points of inflection using the second derivative.
